'''''Silene disticha''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Caryophyllaceae]]. The species is [[Hermaphrodite|hermaphroditic]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Casimiro-Soriguer|first=Inés|last2=Buide|first2=Maria L.|last3=Narbona|first3=Eduardo|date=2015-01-01|title=Diversity of sexual systems within different lineages of the genus Silene|url=https://doi.org/10.1093/aobpla/plv037|journal=AoB Plants|volume=7|issue=plv037|doi=10.1093/aobpla/plv037|issn=2041-2851|pmc=4433491}}</ref> and mainly grows in the [[subtropics]].<ref name="POWO" /> 

It is native to [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], and [[Tunisia]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite POWO|id=157246-1|title=''Silene disticha''|access-date=23 September 2021}}</ref> The species was introduced to the island of [[Corsica]] in 1967.<ref>{{Cite report |url=http://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/10.1079/cabicompendium.117138 |title=Silene disticha |last=CABI |date=2022-01-07 |doi=10.1079/cabicompendium.117138 |language=en|doi-access=free }}</ref>
